rows.note: This is the all-purpose way to express movement toward the south.

example.english: If we walk south, we’ll reach the beach.
example.traditional: 我哋向南行就到海灘喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hoeng3 naam4 haang4 zau6 dou3 hoi2 taan1 laa3

rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the compass direction south.

example.english: If you face east, south is on your right.
example.traditional: 你向住東面企，南就喺你右手邊。
example.jyutping: nei5 hoeng3 zyu6 dung1 min6 kei5 naam4 zau6 hai2 nei5 jau6 sau2 bin1

rows.note: Use 南 as the basic attributive word for something southern or of the south.
Use 向南嘅 for something oriented or moving toward the south, rather than simply being southern.

example.jyutping: ni1 gaa3 ce1 hai6 hoeng3 naam4 ge3

rows.note: Use this for the southern region or area, rather than 南 for a compass bearing.

example.english: Winters in the south are usually not so cold.
example.jyutping: naam4 fong1 dung1 tin1 tung1 soeng4 mou5 gam3 dung3

rows.note: Use this for the inhabitants of a southern region, rather than the region itself.

example.english: They are from the south and love adding chili to their food.
example.traditional: 佢係南方人，食飯好鍾意落辣椒。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 naam4 fong1 jan4 sik6 faan6 hou2 zung1 ji3 lok6 laat6 ziu1

rows.note: Use 由南邊嚟嘅 when something comes from the south.

example.english: This wind comes from the south.
example.jyutping: ni1 zan6 fung1 hai6 jau4 naam4 bin1 lai4 ge3
